name: Clean The Library 📖
desc:
👍THUMBS UP for more UPDATES at 150,000 LIKES 👍

🖥️ PC Controls:

E or Click: Pickup / Place book
Q: Drop book
Scroll: Switch top book
Right Click: Zoom In

🎮 Controller Controls: 

RT - Pickup / Place book
B/O - Drop book
LT - Cycle books
D-Pad - Abilities

📖 Your local library has been turned upside down and the books are everywhere! Unlock your inner librarian and help clean up the mess by sorting thousands of books hidden around the entire library!

👥 Cleanup alone or with friends!
🏁 Race for the fastest times on the leaderboard!
🔓 Earn upgrade and abilities to help make the job easier!

✨ Inspired by "Librarian: Tidy Up the Arcane Library" ✨
